I replied to Ilse in a thread on their #north-random message. I said I'd noted that the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is 10 June, not the date in their #north-team post this morning. A renewal date is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so repeating it there is allowed.

They said no action was needed, so I didn't post a correction in #north-team and didn't change anything else.
